```json { "title": "Shared Todo List", "body": "

🗺️ Weekend Trip Planner

    ", "css": ".todo-app { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 520px; margin: 16px auto; background: #fff; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08); padding: 24px 28px; } h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #2d3748; } .add-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; } #item-input { flex: 1; padding: 10px 14px; border: 2px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .95rem; transition: border-color .2s; outline: none; } #item-input:focus { border-color: #63b3ed; } #add-btn { padding: 10px 18px; background: #3182ce; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: .95rem; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .2s; } #add-btn:hover { background: #2b6cb0; } ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; } li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; background: #f7fafc; transition: background .15s; } li.done { opacity: .55; } li.done span { text-decoration: line-through; color: #a0aec0; } input[type=\"checkbox\"] { width: 18px; height: 18px; cursor: pointer; accent-color: #38a169; } span { flex: 1; font-size: .95rem; color: #2d3748; cursor: default; } .del-btn { padding: 5px 10px; background: #fc8181; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: .8rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .del-btn:hover { background: #e53e3e; } #counter { text-align: right; color: #718096; font-size: .85rem; margin-top: 12px; }", "scripts": [ "if (!state.todos) { state.todos = Object.assign(Object.create(null), { 1: { id: 1, text: 'Book the cabin', done: false }, 2: { id: 2, text: 'Plan hiking routes', done: false }, 3: { id: 3, text: 'Pack camping gear', done: false } }); state.nextId = 4; state.done = true; }", "if (state.todos && !state.done) return;", "const listEl = root.querySelector('#todo-list'); const counterEl = root.querySelector('#counter'); const keys = Object.keys(state.todos); listEl.replaceChildren(); keys.forEach((k) => { const item = state.todos[k]; const li = root.create('li'); if (item.done) li.classList.add('done'); const cb = root.create('input'); cb.type = 'checkbox'; cb.checked = item.done; cb.addEventListener('change', (e) => { state.todos[item.id].done = e.target.checked; }); const span = root.create('span'); span.textContent = item.text; const btn = root.create('button'); btn.className = 'del-btn'; btn.textContent = 'Delete'; btn.addEventListener('click', () => { delete state.todos[item.id]; if (item.id >= state.maxId) state.maxId = item.id - 1; }); li.append(cb, span, btn); listEl.append(li); }); const total = keys.length; const remaining = keys.filter((k) => !state.todos[k].done).length; counterEl.textContent = `${remaining} of ${total} items left`; if (remaining === 0 && total > 0) counterEl.textContent = '🎉 All done!';", "const addBtn = root.querySelector('#add-btn'); const input = root.querySelector('#item-input'); if (!state.maxId) state.maxId = 3; addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { const text = input.value.trim(); if (text) { const id = state.nextId++; state.todos[id] = { id, text, done: false }; if (id > state.maxId) state.maxId = id; input.value = ''; } });" ] } ```
